newsitem.title: USA: Amerada Hess has "high hopes" for Q4.
newsitem.headline: Amerada Hess has "high hopes" for Q4.

text.p: Amerada Hess Corp has "high hopes for the fourth quarter," spokesman Carl Tursi told Reuters.
The company reported third quarter profits, excluding special items, of $26.7 million or $0.29 per share, well above the First Call consensus estimate of $0.29 per share.
The profit compared with a loss of $78.6 million before special items in 1995's September quarter.
The profit came on a 74 percent increase in exploration and production earnings; and a refining, marketing and shipping profit compared with a loss last year.
Adding to the improvement were sharp drops in interest expenses and corporate costs, the company said.

Noting exploration and production earnings of $21.6 million in the latest quarter, Tursi said they had been "held down by hedging. That won't be a problem in the fourth quarter," he said in a telephone interview.

The company said capital spending was $279.4 million in the latest quarter, up from $176.8 million a year earlier. For the first nine months, spending rose to $610.0 million from $509.6 million in 1995. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
